newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Girl mounts TV advertising cleanup in Israel.
newsitem.headline: Girl mounts TV advertising cleanup in Israel.

text.p: A nine-year-old girl worked herself into a lather over a soap commercial she charged was muddying the reputation of children and got Israeli television to scrub the spot.
The Dial soap jingle -- "If you've got children, you've got germs" -- irritated Shahaf Zilberman so much when she saw it on Israel's Channel 2 that she wrote a letter of complaint.
"A commercial must be persuasive to sell itself but a product that makes children into germs isn't worth buying," she told Israel Radio on Tuesday.
"My parents work in medicine and I know what germs are, so that's what irritated me the most," the girl said.
After a couple of weeks, the commercial was changed.
"No question she raised a point," said Channel 2 director-general Nachman Shai.
